title: Corpus-wide omission likelihood ranking across 8,597 units
notes: Processed all N = 8,597 units across 21 sessions in 139.85 s.
Target window: -250 ms to +750 ms relative to omission onset (p2, p3, p4 omissions).
Tagged by quality (single-stable, single-unstable, mua-stable, mua-unstable) and waveform (fast, moderate, slow).
